summary: Mercury Systems filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing that Massachusetts Superior Court entered orders on September 9 and 15, 2026 granting preliminary approval of a settlement of stockholder derivative actions Jones v. Aslett and McKinnon v. Aslett. The company is nominal defendant; individual directors and officers are named defendants. The settlement, agreed July 9, 2026, resolves claims previously disclosed in the FY2026 10-K legal claims note. The stipulation and notice are filed as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. This is a litigation settlement disclosure, not a special-situation transaction; no deal terms apply. Watch for final settlement approval and any related corporate-governance changes.
